messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Hi,

I received my smart watch from Delta Gadgets in Dubai on Thursday, tracking BYL260439062. It works but it is not the model I wanted, the screen is smaller than in the photos.

1) Can I return it with you? The shop said they are on your returns plan.
2) Shipping from Cairo to Dubai was not cheap. If I return it, do I get the shipping cost back too, or do I pay again for the way back?

Thanks
Hassan
